integrity: Proof uses an exact conditional binomial law, an exact finite-state kernel and finite rational inequalities; no infinite generalization or independent certificate is claimed.
limitations: The exact theorem concerns synchronous pull-only K_{a,b}; it identifies the first reversal of the two-round source ranking, not the first stochastic-incomparability example of any kind or a global source-order theorem. Historical priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: The first two-round source-ranking reversal in synchronous pull on \(K_{a,b}\)
